notes:
OCRelay 1.1.22

FIX: THE RIGHT REPORT WHEN TWO ARE OPEN

• When PowerScribe has a second report open beside the one you are reading, OCRelay now checks and fills the report that matches the study. Before, it could pick the other, longer report: values showed as "no matching report line", the fill pasted the whole report (flattening its pick lists) or nothing at all, and the study picker could jump to the other report's study.

FIX: PROBLEM REPORTS NOW ARRIVE

• Problem reports, both automatic and from "Report a problem", were being refused by the server for everyone except administrators. They now go through. Reports saved on your computer while they were being refused are sent automatically the next time OCRelay starts.
